name: opencode
summary: An open source coding agent that runs in the terminal, as a server and through an SDK, and works with models from many providers.

skills.what: Skills: a SKILL.md file in .opencode/skills/<skill-id>, also found in .claude/skills, .agents/skills and their global equivalents.

mcp.what: MCP servers: local servers that opencode starts over stdio, and remote servers over Streamable HTTP.

plugins.what: Plugins in opencode's own format: npm packages, Git repositories, local directories or .ts and .js files that add tools, hooks, commands, agents and other behavior. The pages checked do not mention Agent Plugins or plugin.json.

hooks.what: Plugin hooks registered in the plugin's code, such as the tool execute.before and execute.after hooks and session hooks, plus a read-only event stream.

scheduled-work.what: Automations (experimental) send a prompt, run a Code Mode program or run a shell command at a time, every interval or on a cron schedule.

sandboxes.what: Code Mode's execute tool runs agent-written JavaScript in a runtime with no direct filesystem access, imports or timers. The pages checked describe no isolated environment for shell commands.
